+def _safe_percentile(data: List[float], pct: float) -> Optional[float]:
+    """Return the pct-th percentile of data (sorted)."""
+    if not data:
+        return None
+    sorted_data = sorted(data)
+    k = (len(sorted_data) - 1) * pct / 100.0
+    f = math.floor(k)
+    c = math.ceil(k)
+    if f == c:
+        return sorted_data[int(k)]
+    d0 = sorted_data[int(f)] * (c - k)
+    d1 = sorted_data[int(c)] * (k - f)
+    return d0 + d1
